title: Popsicle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="popGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF6B9D"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#FF8A65"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFB74D"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="stickGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE082"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFCA28"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stick -->
  <rect x="43" y="72" width="14" height="24" rx="3" fill="url(#stickGrad)"/>
  <rect x="43" y="72" width="6" height="24" rx="3" fill="#FFECB3" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- popsicle body -->
  <rect x="22" y="10" width="56" height="66" rx="18" fill="url(#popGrad)"/>

  <!-- lighter highlight on body edge -->
  <rect x="24" y="12" width="52" height="62" rx="16" fill="none" stroke="#FFCDD2" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- top lighter band -->
  <path d="M22 28 Q22 10 40 10 L60 10 Q78 10 78 28 Z" fill="#FFB3C1" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="38" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#5C2D91"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="38" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#5C2D91"/>
  <ellipse cx="39.5" cy="36" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#E1BEE7"/>
  <ellipse cx="63.5" cy="36" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#E1BEE7"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M36 52 Q50 66 64 52" fill="none" stroke="#5C2D91" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- cheek blushes -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="50" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#FF5252" opacity="0.45"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="50" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#FF5252" opacity="0.45"/>

  <!-- tiny sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(70,20)">
    <path d="M0-5 L1.2-1.2 L5 0 L1.2 1.2 L0 5 L-1.2 1.2 L-5 0 L-1.2-1.2 Z" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  </g>
</svg>
